stories.title: Fiona the hippo has died, Cincinnati Zoo says
stories.summary: Fiona the hippo, who survived being born prematurely and rose to global fame, has died, the Cincinnati Zoo & Botanical Garden announced Thursday.

stories.title: Westmoreland County Prison Board names new warden
stories.summary: The Westmoreland County Prison Board voted to name Joseph Roemmich the new warden.

stories.title: 17-year-old high school student killed in Lawrence County crash
stories.summary: A 17-year-old girl was killed and two women were seriously injured in a crash in Lawrence County on Thursday morning, Pennsylvania State Police said.

stories.title: Pittsburgh nurses rally together as UPMC Magee Women's nurses push for union contract
stories.summary: A caravan of vehicles, nurses from around the city, and elected leaders rallied on Thursday as Magee nurses continue to push for a union contract.

stories.title: Westmoreland County Prison Board names new warden
stories.summary: For the last five years, the Westmoreland County Prison has had a churning of leadership for various reasons — two permanent wardens and one interim — but Thursday, the Westmoreland County Prison Board voted unanimously to name Joseph Roemmich the new warden. KDKA's Chris DeRose

stories.title: Nurses across Pittsburgh rally in support of Magee union fight
stories.summary: A caravan of vehicles, nurses from around the city, and elected leaders rallied on Thursday as Magee nurses continue to push for a union contract. KDKA's Josh Taylor has the story.

stories.title: Man sentenced 5 to 25 years in drowning death of 13-year-old girl swimming in West Virginia
stories.summary: A man will spend at least five years in prison after a 13-year-old girl drowned while swimming in the Ohio River in West Virginia last year.

stories.title: Man sentenced 5 to 25 years in drowning death of 13-year-old girl swimming in West Virginia
stories.summary: A man will spend at least five years in prison after a 13-year-old girl drowned while swimming in the Ohio River in West Virginia last year. KDKA's Mamie Bah reports.

stories.title: Fiona, beloved hippo at Cincinnati Zoo, dies
stories.summary: Fiona, a beloved hippo at Cincinnati Zoo, died after eating a visitor's hat that had accidentally been tossed into her enclosure.

stories.title: Suspect wanted for illegal hunting in Wilkinsburg turns himself in, given multiple citations
stories.summary: The person wanted for illegally hunting a white-tailed deer in the front yard of a Wilkinsburg home has turned himself in.

stories.title: Man in Westmoreland County arrested after allegedly walking into a police station carrying a gun
stories.summary: A man walked into the Arnold Police Department with a gun and threatened to kill officers.

stories.title: Game Commission says man wanted for illegal hunting turns himself in
stories.summary: A man who was wanted for illegally hunting a white-tailed deer in a Wilkinsburg neighborhood turned himself in.
